---
title: "5.1_single_species_aoh_patches_pu_process"
output: html_document
params:
  target_species: "Cryptoprocta ferox"
  species_csv: "Data/Clean/species_table.csv"
  landcover_tif: "Data/Raw/esacci_2022_pfts.tif"
  grass_dir: ""
  roi_xmin: 43.18
  roi_xmax: 50.56
  roi_ymin: -25.64
  roi_ymax: -11.89
---

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Single-species visual walkthrough of habitat-mask, mapped-habitat, patch, and
# population-unit construction. This script is for figure production only; it does
# not create canonical pipeline inputs.

if (requireNamespace("knitr", quietly = TRUE)) {
  knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
}

source("R/patch_config.R")
source("R/figure_utils.R")
load_patch_packages(include_figures = TRUE)
source("R/patch_species_inputs.R")
source("R/patch_habitat.R")
source("R/patch_processing.R")
source("R/patch_process_figure.R")

paths <- patch_paths(params)
run_options <- patch_run_options(params)
roi <- patch_roi(params)

validate_patch_config(
  paths = paths,
  run_options = run_options,
  roi = roi,
  production = FALSE
)
```

```{r target_species}
target_row <- read_single_patch_species(
  species_csv = paths$species_csv,
  target_species = params$target_species
)

message("Target species OK: ", target_row$scientificName)
```

```{r compute_single_species_layers}
layers <- build_single_species_layers(
  target_row = target_row,
  paths = paths,
  roi = roi
)

labels_mixed <- layers$labels_mixed
habitat01 <- layers$habitat01
presence01 <- layers$presence01
mapped_habitat01 <- layers$mapped_habitat01
n_raw_patches <- layers$n_raw_patches
n_kept_patches <- layers$n_kept_patches
n_candidate_pus <- layers$n_candidate_pus
n_final_pus <- layers$n_final_pus
```

```{r make_process_figure, fig.width=8.5, fig.height=9.1, dpi=300}
process_figure <- make_single_species_process_figure(layers)
save_manuscript_figure(process_figure, "spatial_process")
process_figure
```

```{r figure_summary, echo=FALSE}
cat("\nSingle-species process summary\n")
cat("==============================\n")
cat("Species: ", target_row$scientificName, "\n", sep = "")
cat("Distribution raster: ", target_row$raster_path, "\n", sep = "")
cat("Habitat labels: ", paste(labels_mixed, collapse = ", "), "\n", sep = "")
cat("Mapped-habitat area: ", fmt_area_km2(raster_area_km2(mapped_habitat01)), "\n", sep = "")
cat("Raw patches: ", n_raw_patches, "\n", sep = "")
cat("Retained patches: ", n_kept_patches, "\n", sep = "")
cat("Candidate population units: ", n_candidate_pus, "\n", sep = "")
cat("Final population units: ", n_final_pus, "\n", sep = "")
```
